name: Zenith Healthcare Limited
summary: Zenith Healthcare Ltd. is a pharmaceutical company that specializes in producing a variety of drug formulations, encompassing tablets, capsules, oral suspensions, and injectable solutions. Its comprehensive product portfolio extends across a wide array of therapeutic areas, such as antibiotics and anti-infectives, as well as treatments targeting the cardiovascular, central nervous, gastrointestinal, musculoskeletal, respiratory, and genitourinary systems. Additionally, the company offers nutritional products, dermatological solutions, and medications for the endocrine system. Mahendra C. Raycha founded the enterprise on November 15, 1994, and its main operations are based in Ahmedabad, India.
